scope: Per-member propagation is not the released method. MEAN tests "effectively propagated" as the release's evaluation path does it; PER-MEMBER asks whether the ensemble's information would propagate if the members were rolled out separately. The release's imagination path, which propagates one member per environment, is not tested.
caveats: rel: all ten episodes, in-sample for the released checkpoint only if it trained on this recording (PREMISES P20); no in-sample/held-out contrast is drawn from it
n = 4 results are descriptive: no n = 4 test can reach p < 0.125
ind3 and fold have three members; a small ensemble's spread is biased low
